response.message: Astra: Your proposed within-sleep timing windows are a new research question, not a reported comparison; they also do not establish a basis for aromatherapy treatment. Set that precision question aside for now. Looking at the reported declarative–procedural contrast, spend attention on how narrowly the result should travel: what can you say about these tested tasks without extending it to all learning or all procedural memory? A concise boundary is enough; no additional mechanism is needed.
response.rationale: Redirects attention from unsupported timing precision and therapeutic extrapolation to the same study’s reported task contrast, without reopening repeated missing-design checks.
